_README: Single source of truth for the talent roster. Add an entry, then run: python3 tools/build-talents.py  — it regenerates every profile page, the roster cards, the schema and the sitemap. NEVER put talent contact details (email/phone/Instagram) in here; bookings route through YKS only, and the build script will refuse if it finds any.

talent.name: Shalini Singh
talent.bio: A professional model and digital creator working across fashion, editorial and commercial print. She moves easily between the controlled language of a studio call and the faster, looser register of content — a range that makes her equally castable for a lookbook, a runway line-up or a campaign that has to live on a phone. On set she is a fast study: quick to take direction, precise with hands and jawline, and comfortable holding a look for as long as the frame needs.
